mapper.insert: insert into user_profile(user_id, birthday, school, major, hometown, signature, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{birthday}, #{school}, #{major}, #{hometown}, #{signature}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update user_profile set birthday = #{birthday}, school = #{school}, major = #{major}, hometown = #{hometown}, signature = #{signature}, update_time = #{updateTime} where user_id = #{userId}
